scope: Temperature skyline experiment only; excludes pre-existing Samudra baseline training and unrelated concurrent jobs
method: Sum ElapsedRaw times allocated GPU count over sacct job allocation rows, with --duplicates to retain requeued segments. Excludes step rows. Includes startup, data wait, validation, checkpointing, failed and preempted allocations. Pending-only jobs contribute zero. GPU types are not performance-normalized.
